title: Polaris : Multi Agentic System for Conversational Enterprise Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2608.14246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In today's fast-paced environment, the ability to swiftly access, understand, and act on data is no longer optional; it is essential. Yet most organizations remain data-rich but insight-poor, constrained by the complexity of querying, interpreting, and explaining enterprise-scale information. We present Polaris, a supervisor-led multi-agent framework for conversational enterprise analytics that bridges this gap. Polaris introduces Dynamic Task Coordination (DTC), a decision-theoretic orchestration layer that models agent-task assignment as adaptive bipartite matching, enabling real-time coordination, recovery, and optimization across specialized agents for querying, visualization, and reasoning. By coupling DTC with reason-first, ReAct-style agents, Polaris transforms natural-language queries into coherent analytical workflows that not only retrieve and visualize data but also explain the underlying "why." translated_title: 北极星：面向对话式企业分析的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.14246v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在当今快节奏的环境中，快速访问、理解和操作数据的能力不再是可选项，而是必需的。然而，大多数组织仍然数据丰富但洞察力贫乏，受限于查询、解释和阐述企业规模信息的复杂性。我们提出了Polaris，一个由监督者领导的多智能体框架，用于对话式企业分析，填补了这一差距。Polaris引入了动态任务协调（DTC），这是一种决策理论驱动的编排层，将智能体-任务分配建模为自适应二分匹配，实现在查询、可视化和推理等专业智能体之间的实时协调、恢复和优化。通过将DTC与优先推理、ReAct风格的智能体相结合，Polaris将自然语言查询转化为连贯的分析工作流，不仅检索和可视化数据，还解释潜在的“为什么”。在结构化企业数据上的评估表明，该系统在任务完成和用户满意度方面均优于基线方法，显著减少了分析延迟并提高了洞察准确性。
tldr: Polaris通过动态任务协调和ReAct智能体，将自然语言查询转化为可解释的企业分析工作流，提升了数据洞察的速度和准确性。
en_tdlr: Polaris leverages dynamic task coordination and ReAct-style agents to transform natural-language queries into interpretable enterprise analytical workflows, enhancing the speed and accuracy of data insights.
